description: This is a Java source file implementing the ChargeWritePlatformService interface. It contains methods for creating, updating, and deleting charge entities within the system, including handling related entities such as GL accounts, tax groups, and payment types. The class manages database interactions, enforces business rules, and handles data integrity issues.

classes.name: ChargeWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing CRUD operations for charges, including transaction management, data integrity handling, and business rule enforcement.

methods.name: createCharge
methods.description: Creates a new charge entity after validation, linking related entities such as GL accounts, tax groups, and payment types. Handles database persistence and cache eviction.

methods.name: updateCharge
methods.description: Updates an existing charge with new data, validating input, checking business rules, and persisting changes. Supports updating linked entities like account, tax group, and payment type.

methods.name: deleteCharge
methods.description: Deletes a charge if it's not associated with any active loans or savings, handling logical deletion and cache eviction.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles database integrity violations, throwing detailed exceptions for duplicate names or unknown issues.

methods.name: isAnyLoansAssociateWithThisCharge
methods.description: Checks if active loans are linked to the given charge.

methods.name: isAnySavingsAssociateWithThisCharge
methods.description: Checks if active savings accounts are linked to the given charge.

methods.name: isAnyLoanProductsAssociateWithThisCharge
methods.description: Checks if loan products are associated with the charge.

methods.name: isAnySavingsProductsAssociateWithThisCharge
methods.description: Checks if savings products are associated with the charge.
